Dave Matthews Band
June 9, 2023
Forest Hills Stadium - Forest Hills, NY

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source 1: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front House Right Corner of FOH, Slightly Right of DFC, Approx. 115' from Stage Lip, Mics PAS @ 13'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.80 (Gain, Mixing/Post Processing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.3.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

01. Intro
02. One Sweet World¹
03. Dave Speak: Smokey Manhattan
04. When the World Ends
05. Busted Stuff
06. Pantala Naga Pampa >
07. Rapunzel
08. Dave Speak: Borders are Bullshit
09. Looking for a Vein
10. Madman's Eyes
11. Funny the Way It Is
12. Kill the Preacher
13. Why I Am
14. Walk Around the Moon
15. JTR²
16. You & Me
17. The Only Thing
18. Jimi Thing >
19. Brick House³ (Partial)
20. #41⁴
21. It Could Happen
22. Warehouse⁵
23. Crash Into Me⁶
24. You Might Die Trying⁷
25. Encore Break
26. Monsters
27. Granny
28. Crush⁸

Set Time: [02:41:30.493]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ Swim Naked outro
² played in response to crowd chants after the rain started
³ The Commodores cover
⁴ with "Empire State of Mind" (Jay-Z/Alicia Keys) interpolation
⁵ improv intro; with "Louie Louie" interpolation
⁶ with "Dixie Chicken" interpolation
⁷ Dave skips the lyrics to half of the first verse
⁸ very brief Stefan solo intro

Heavy rain started to fall during "Walk Around the Moon" through "JTR", causing my mics to become wet. There's a few heavy pops of rain that I've edited to be less jarring during these sections.

There is a brief "Hope For Tomorrow" tease from Dave between "JTR" and "You & Me".

This recording is dedicated to Jaclyn Hensen Aochoa and all those who loved her. May her spirit continue to live on through them and through the music of Dave Matthews.

Compiled on 2023/06/14.
